rows.grounds: compound aṣṭa + kūṭa; accusative singular neuter

items.question: Which elements become present in the upper temple region?
premises: The upper region has an eight-cornered top.
Eight-kūṭa chamber and nest thus become.
items.inference: The upper temple region includes an eight-kūṭa chamber and nest.
uncertainties: The exact ritual function of nīḍaka remains unclear.
items.plain_english: Thus an eight-kūṭa chamber and nest become there.
